title: Function Ciscoasaparser
author: reprise99
description: Save as a function in your workspace then invoke via its name, i.e if you save as ASALogs ASALogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where Action == "A real IP packet was denied by the ACL" ASALogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where DstIP == "1.1.1.1" This will parse the Syslog messages from a Cisco ASA appliance to separate columns
